status: frozen protocol; commit and push complete runner before evaluation
class: Original K on the full closed unit square, uniform marginals, density in [1/2,3/2], Euclidean Lipschitz constant <=2; full strict directed order from one iid sample, no supplied coordinates or anchors.
candidate: Literal accepted degree estimator specialized to existing dense API 2<=n<=4096. Its exact proof branch is flat throughout this range; no implementation of the enormous-n active histogram is claimed. The complete order and an independently checked realizer are still validated.
parameter_audit: Exhaust all supported integer n and occupancy-feasible m<=floor(sqrt(n)); the retained proof's shell term 6s/ell, s=32/m, ell<=1, is at least 192/m>=3. Parameter-only tuning of this displayed bound cannot yield radius<1/2 here. This diagnoses a certificate, not every estimator or sharper proof.
input_contract: All methods receive the same full strict order, n and fixed method settings only. Arbitrary vertex labels carry no coordinates; estimator modules never receive truth parameters, sample coordinates or seeds. One global identity/transpose applies to all density cells.
diagnostics: latent-coordinate clipped histogram on the same 8x8 grid, with no confidence claim
families: rho=1+c*f(u)*g(v). fgm: f=g=2t-1. asymmetric: f=2t-1, g=6t^2-6t+1. boundary8: f=g=(1-t)^8-t^8. legendre4: f=g=(35*(2t-1)^4-30*(2t-1)^2+3)/8. Each factor integrates to zero. Range and derivative checks are recorded before evaluation.

misspecified_density_control.expectation: Outside original K; known-range confidence bands cannot contain the full-square true density. Not counted as coverage failure of an admitted model.

sampling: NumPy PCG64 uniform proposals on the square, independently accept with probability rho/2, stop at first n. Abort above 8*n proposals, with no resampling of failed trials. All scoped densities are bounded by 2. Reject finite-precision coordinate ties. Float sampling is a diagnostic rather than proof of exact continuous sampling semantics.
seed_rule: SeedSequence([seed,phase_index,size_index,model_index,replicate]); pilot=0, optional confirmation=1, misspecified=2. No tuning from pilot samples and no reuse of historical pilot samples.
retained_evidence: Every pilot coordinate sample and full relation, seed and proposal counts; both computed reports and exact check results; truth extrema, errors/coverage/widths, oracle diagnostic, stage timings and per-worker resource receipt. Gzip JSON deterministic metadata. Never overwrite an attempt.
density_metrics: Exact rational extrema for each polynomial on every closed grid cell give full-square histogram error and band coverage. Assess both global orientations, never choose orientation independently per cell. Flat and degree outputs use exact constant extension. Cell-average coverage uses exact integrals. No finite-grid maximum is mislabeled full-square error.
metamorphic_checks: For the first valid trial of each size, rerun both computed estimators after reversing sample labels and check density/band output and report validity; certificate permutations need not match. Reconstruct chronology from swapped latent axes and verify the same relation. The asymmetric models test the evaluator's single global orientation rule.
practical_gate: At n=3072 in both FGM +/-1/2 strata, every pilot replicate must have candidate simultaneous maximum width<=9/10 and radius<=9/20, and full-square error at least 1/20 below BOTH paired flat and split-DKW point estimates; all valid reports must verify, cover, and meet resource limits. Passing only triggers confirmation; it is not a population utility or uniform coverage claim. Literal full-width output deterministically fails this gate.
coverage_precision: Report two-sided exact 95% binomial intervals for per-stratum joint density coverage, with no claim that two pilot trials validate 95% coverage. Any confirmation, if warranted after an explicitly justified revision, uses 128 fresh trials for each of the two target FGM strata at n=3072. Precompute exact binomial rejection threshold for undercoverage at nominal .95 with per-stratum size .025 and power at actual .85. Require power>=.9. Coverage certification remains mathematical, not inferred from these finite strata.
revision_gate: At most one revised candidate, only after a documented substantive improvement beyond parameter-only tuning of the audited proof expression; freeze its complete implementation and fresh protocol before generating new data. No revision is automatically warranted by a failed literal candidate. Conditional confirmation seeds remain ungenerated if no candidate qualifies.

resources.resource_supervisor: existing Windows Job Object single-process worker; children prohibited, hard committed-memory limit and 10-ms RSS/time rejection watchdog; report possible RSS overshoot honestly

costs: Include imports, coordinate sampling, full relation construction, candidate input validation/realizer, baseline confidence/LP/report checks, oracle/metric evaluation and serialization. Record stage and wall costs. No runtime superiority based only on a flat-output shortcut; retain actual worker peak RSS and committed memory.
source_custody: Commit and push all sources before sampling; record interpreter and NumPy/SciPy versions and source identities; require clean matching local/remote main. Preserve historical proofs, pilots, publications and failed attempts. Review serialized reports independently.
certification: No new statistical theorem is introduced by the exact flat specialization. Its guarantee is the accepted branch plus original-K pointwise bounds. Substantive new bounds from any revised candidate require ordinary proofs and GCP-only Lean acceptance. No local Lean invocation.
decision: Continue only with informative uncertainty and meaningful paired improvement at the frozen resource ceiling, supported by the required proof and confirmation. Otherwise park this literal practical candidate with diagnosed constant/computation limits; do not infer universal statistical impossibility. Publish no new manuscript or DOI as part of S039.
